title: Integrate the interacting bulk and fast modes together
statement: At paid mesh M,introduce Gaussian variables for S=RR^T and AA^T,split collective coordinates into slow s/fast u,and put w=(v,u). Conditional spin traces are explicit one-spin transfer products exp(delta Gamma_i X)exp([delta b_i+sqrt(delta)(Rv_k+Ay_k)_i]Z). Thus Z_M=exp(beta n gamma/2)E_s E_w W(w,s),U_s(w)=||w||^2/2-log W. The SAME tilted chain law controls bulk/fast cross covariance. With theta=1-kappa chi_M>=rho/2,c_bulk<=1-theta,c_fast<=4Lambda/Omega and integer K>=0,K+1>=4beta Lambda/(pi theta),one earns(theta/2)I<=Hess U_s<=I for EVERY s,w. d=r min(M,2K+1) counts the Nyquist mode once. The value/gradient oracle pays spatial transforms,FFT and forward/backward transfer products; it is not a nested many-body partition/Hessian oracle. Zero rates,scalar normalizations,r0/d0/D0 branches remain explicit.

requires: Explicit rational or polynomial-time certifiably computable J,b,beta,Gamma_i>=0; guarded acquisition J=gamma I+S+AA^T with S>=0,||S||<=kappa,rank(AA^T)=r,||AA^T||<=Lambda. All acquisition,precision,norm and scalar beta n gamma/2 costs retained.

Bulk susceptibility kappa chi_beta<=1-rho,rho>0,chi_beta=tanh(beta Gamma_min)/Gamma_min or beta at Gamma_min0; elementary beta kappa<=1-rho is separately sufficient. Fixed beta,r,Lambda,physical coefficient bounds and margin for the promised complexity class.

Microscopic mesh and finite-grid margin paid. High-frequency modes are integrated jointly with the bulk,not deleted. No free phase labels,eigenstates,mode discovery,exact center or nested interacting-normalizer oracle.
